entities.name: Deborah
entities.description: One of the two people in this conversation: a yoga teacher who runs neighbourhood classes, workshops, events and retreats and builds community around them. Her mother died a few years before 2023 and her father suddenly on 25 January 2023; she is married, keeps two cats (Luna and Max), lost her friend Karlie in February 2023, and returns often to her mother's old house and to the park near her home. She met Jolene on 23 January 2023 and her neighbour Anna on 31 January 2023.

entities.name: Jolene
entities.description: The other person in this conversation: an engineering student whose projects run from an electrical engineering project finished in January 2023 to a water purifier, a robotics project and an aerial surveillance prototype. She keeps two pet snakes (Susie and Seraphim), games with her partner of about three years, has practised yoga and meditation sporadically for about three years as of 2023, and began an internship at an engineering firm by June 2023. Her mother died in 2022.

entities.name: Anna
entities.description: Deborah's neighbour, met at yoga in the park on 31 January 2023. She attends Deborah's yoga classes, bonded with her over difficult poses on 3 February 2023, wears a pendant in memory of her own mother, bought her a vegan stir-fry in late February 2023, started a running group with her by July 2023, heard her life story on 18 August 2023 and ran a free community gardening class with her on 16 September 2023.

entities.name: Karlie
entities.description: A friend of Deborah's who died in the week before 22 February 2023. The last photograph of the two of them together was taken on a hike in the summer of 2022, and Deborah spent time in a garden of roses and dahlias for comfort after losing her.

entities.name: Deborah's mother
entities.description: Deborah's mother, who died a few years before 2023. She married Deborah's father in 1993, read by the bench at the window of her house every morning and evening, loved travel, art, flowers and cooking, baked pineapple birthday cakes for Deborah, sang her lullabies, came to Deborah's early yoga classes as her biggest supporter, and left her the pendant Deborah carries and the cat Max.

entities.name: Deborah's father
entities.description: Deborah's father, who died suddenly on 25 January 2023, leaving the family shell-shocked. He married Deborah's mother in 1993.

entities.name: Deborah's husband
entities.description: Deborah's husband. They married on the beach Deborah loves, where she also discovered surfing; they used to play detective video games together and enjoyed exploring the outdoors, and he was photographed in front of her mother's old house around August 2023.

entities.name: Jolene's mother
entities.description: Jolene's mother, who died in 2022. She gave Jolene the heart-shaped pendant in Paris in 2010, played video games with her as a child — 'Monster Hunter: World' was their favourite — and taught her never to give up and to help others, values Jolene now carries into her engineering work.

entities.name: Jolene's father
entities.description: Jolene's father, who supported her interest in video games as a child without teaching her to play; she taught herself.

entities.name: Jolene's partner

properties.aliases: her bf; her boyfriend; her significant other

entities.description: Jolene's partner of about three years as of February 2023, whom she met in an engineering class at college. They are not married, game together constantly, took up yoga alongside her, travelled to Rio de Janeiro in August 2023 and to a meditation retreat in Phuket from 9 September 2023, and tried scuba diving together on 15 September 2023. His own father taught him to stay determined.

entities.name: Neal Stephenson
entities.description: The author of the novel Jolene calls 'Avalanche', which she read in one sitting about two weeks before 4 February 2023.

entities.name: Nils Frahm
entities.description: A musician Jolene listens to during her yoga practice, named on 28 March 2023 as calming music that puts her in a different headspace.

entities.name: Olafur Arnalds
entities.description: A musician Jolene listens to during her yoga practice, named alongside Nils Frahm on 28 March 2023.

entities.name: Susie
entities.description: One of Jolene's two pet snakes, adopted around 2021 when she was feeling lonely and wanted company. Jolene introduced her to Deborah on 27 January 2023, leaned on her during the project setback of late July 2023, and said on 15 September 2023 that she had had her for two years.

entities.name: Seraphim
entities.description: Jolene's second pet snake, bought in Paris around 2022. She once slid out of her cage and coiled up beside Jolene during a video game, went to the park on 26 February 2023, escaped once and was found hours later under the bed, and was given a new aquarium on 24 June 2023.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: One of Deborah's two cats, taken from a shelter; she was five years old in August 2023. Deborah takes her cats out to the park for a run every morning and evening.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Deborah's other cat, originally her mother's; Deborah took him in when her mother died. He was eight years old in August 2023.

entities.name: Deborah's mother's old house
entities.description: The old house of Deborah's mother, kept as a place of memory. It has a bench by the window where her mother read every morning and evening, and a spot by the water nearby where Deborah reflects. Deborah visited it in the week before 23 January 2023, does yoga there, took her husband there around August 2023, visited it in July 2023, and sat on its bench again on 10 September 2023.

entities.name: The park near Deborah's house
entities.description: The park near Deborah's home, with a forest trail, a beach and a bench that holds memories of her mother, where they used to talk about dreams and life and once watched a sunset together in silence. Deborah does yoga and reflects there, met Anna at yoga in the park on 31 January 2023, took her first morning jog there on 24 February 2023, and walks her cats there twice a day.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city where Jolene's mother gave her the heart-shaped pendant in 2010 and where Jolene bought her snake Seraphim around 2022.

entities.name: France
entities.description: The country containing Paris, where Jolene's mother gave her the pendant in 2010 and where she later bought Seraphim.

entities.name: Bali
entities.description: A gorgeous island Deborah travelled to in 2022 and counts among her favourite trips; she found it peaceful and good for yoga.

entities.name: Bogota
entities.description: The city where Jolene spent a vacation in the summer of 2022, watching the sunset over the water and finding nature's calming power there.

entities.name: Colombia
entities.description: The country containing Bogota, where Jolene holidayed in the summer of 2022.

entities.name: Rio de Janeiro
entities.description: The Brazilian city Jolene and her partner returned from on 29 August 2023 after trying local yoga classes, visiting cafes, going on excursions and climbing the stairs of an old temple. Deborah had also visited it around 2020 and photographed a large stone structure there.

entities.name: Brazil
entities.description: The country containing Rio de Janeiro, visited by Jolene and her partner in August 2023 and by Deborah around 2020.

entities.name: Phuket
entities.description: The place in Thailand where Jolene and her partner went on a meditation retreat from the weekend of 9 September 2023, staying a few weeks; its nature and one session on releasing expectations made the strongest impression on her.

entities.name: Thailand
entities.description: The country containing Phuket, where Jolene and her partner attended a meditation retreat in September 2023 and tried a style of meditation using flowers.

entities.name: Mount Talkeetna
entities.description: The mountain on top of which Jolene did yoga on the morning of 5 June 2023, while trying to find work-life balance during her internship.

entities.name: Deborah's yoga classes
entities.description: The yoga classes, workshops and events Deborah teaches, and the community around them. Her students sent her a thank-you letter received on 26 January 2023; she started a class for her neighbours on 10 March 2023, bought new props and a scented candle for it in March 2023, organised a yoga event with food stalls and live music in July 2023, led a session for the elderly at a local care home in August 2023, and wrote a meditation guide for her retreat by 12 August 2023. Her yoga friends, she says, are a second family.

entities.name: Deborah and Anna's running group
entities.description: The running group Deborah started with Anna, first described on 9 July 2023, whose members help and push each other on runs and make it easier to stay motivated.

entities.name: Jolene's engineering school
entities.description: The college where Jolene studies engineering. She met her partner in an engineering class there, a professor set her the large robotics project in early 2023, her assignments and exams repeatedly overwhelmed her through 2023, and she had finals in September 2023.

entities.name: The engineering firm where Jolene interned
entities.description: A well-known engineering firm where Jolene began an internship by 6 June 2023. She valued applying what she had learned at school to real projects and being around people who love their work, but found the work-life balance hard.

entities.name: Sapiens
entities.description: A book on human history and technology's effect on us that Jolene was reading in February 2023 and found fascinating and thought-provoking.

entities.name: Avalanche
entities.description: The Neal Stephenson novel Jolene read in one sitting about two weeks before 4 February 2023.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The console game Jolene and her partner played together in the week before 27 January 2023.

entities.name: The Walking Dead
entities.description: The console game Jolene and her partner planned to play on the Saturday after 27 January 2023.

entities.name: It Takes Two
entities.description: The competitive team-strategy co-op game Jolene and her partner love playing together, named on 9 July 2023 as a way they bond.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
entities.description: The Switch open-world game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023.

entities.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
entities.description: The calming, cute game Jolene recommended to Deborah on 19 August 2023.

entities.name: Overcooked 2
entities.description: The chaotic co-op cooking game Jolene and her partner often play for bets; she once won three large pizzas off him.

entities.name: Battlefield 1
entities.description: The console game Jolene and her partner were given in the week before 21 August 2023.

entities.name: Monster Hunter: World
entities.description: One of Jolene's favourite games and the one she most liked playing with her mother, praised on 3 September 2023 for its immersive story and open world.

entities.name: Savana
entities.description: An instrumental track with a mellow melody that is one of Deborah's favourites to play during her yoga practice.

entities.name: Sleep
entities.description: An album Deborah listens to for meditation and deep relaxation, recommended to Jolene on 28 March 2023.

entities.name: Jolene's heart-shaped pendant
entities.description: The heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it that Jolene's mother gave her in Paris in 2010. Its symbol stands for freedom to Jolene and reminds her to go for her goals and not be held back.

entities.name: Deborah's pendant from her mother
entities.description: The pendant and amulet Deborah keeps in memory of her mother — referred to both as her pendant on 23 January 2023 and as the amulet from her mother on 4 February 2023, and treated here as one object. She brings it to the spot by the water near her mother's old house, and holding it lets her feel her mother's love.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: The practice at the centre of Deborah's life and work: it helped her through a rough time, she teaches it and builds community around it, and she practises it at home, in her mother's old house, in the park and on the beach. Jolene has practised it sporadically for about three years as of 2023 — on Mount Talkeetna, at retreats in Rio de Janeiro and Phuket — and uses it to manage the stress of engineering study.

entities.name: Meditation
entities.description: A daily practice for both women. Deborah meditates each morning and wrote a meditation guide for her retreat by August 2023; Jolene uses breathing and meditation whenever she is overwhelmed, credits it with keeping her clear-headed after losing her work files, signed up for a meditation course on 6 September 2023 and spent weeks at a meditation retreat in Phuket from 9 September 2023.

entities.name: Playing video games
entities.description: Jolene's hobby since childhood — her parents gave her a console when she was ten and she taught herself to play — and now something she shares constantly with her partner, from 'Detroit' to 'It Takes Two', 'Overcooked 2' and 'Battlefield 1'. Deborah used to play with her husband, preferring detective games, but had not played for a while by August 2023.

entities.name: Running
entities.description: Running, which Deborah took up with a first morning jog in the park on 24 February 2023 and decided to make part of her daily routine; by July 2023 she had turned it into a running group with Anna.

entities.name: Surfing
entities.description: Surfing: Deborah discovered a love for it at the beach where she married and had surfed by September 2023, while Jolene had been gathering videos and a beginners' guide since March 2023 and had still not tried it by 17 September 2023, when the two agreed to go together.

entities.name: Gardening
entities.description: Gardening: Deborah finds comfort among roses and dahlias, spent time in a garden after losing Karlie in February 2023, and ran a free gardening class for the community with Anna on 16 September 2023 to share her love of plants.

entities.name: Scuba diving
entities.description: Scuba diving, which Jolene and her partner tried for the first time in a lesson on 15 September 2023; they found a dive spot to explore together and she hopes one day to be a certified diver. Deborah is interested in underwater life but had never tried it.

entities.name: Jolene's electrical engineering project
entities.description: The electrical engineering project Jolene finished in the week before 23 January 2023 after a great deal of work — the first thing she told Deborah about herself.

entities.name: Jolene's sustainable water purifier
entities.description: The sustainable water purifier Jolene planned, researched, designed and built for a rural community in need. It reached its milestone in the week before 4 February 2023, and seeing it deliver clean water felt surreal and gave her a sense of purpose.

entities.name: Jolene's robotics project
entities.description: The large robotics project Jolene's engineering professor set her in early 2023. She felt excited and nervous when she received it and came to enjoy it like a puzzle; she found neat solutions at her retreat on 1 February 2023, had a breakthrough on 24 March 2023, and wrapped it up in May 2023 with a solar-powered vehicle as the result.

entities.name: Jolene's STEM volunteer programme
entities.description: Jolene's idea, proposed on 9 February 2023, for a volunteer programme in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged children through workshops run with local schools and centres, with engineers invited as guest speakers. She sketched it in her planner but had contacted nobody, wanting to solidify the plan first.

entities.name: Jolene's aerial surveillance prototype
entities.description: The prototype Jolene began by 12 August 2023 for a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system, intended to help with emergency response and environmental monitoring.

entities.name: Deborah's community cleanup
entities.description: The community cleanup Deborah started and raised funds for by 1 August 2023; she was moved by how everyone came together to make a difference.
